reason: I put on free YouTube ASMR with a 30-minute timer every night and it works fine for me. I've never paid for a sleep app, and fading the sound out a bit more smoothly isn't worth a monthly fee when my AirPods already stop when I fall asleep.
objection: My YouTube setup already does this for free. Twenty minutes of difference in when the sound stops won't change how I sleep, so I'd end up just paying for a timer.
would_change_my_mind: If the 14-day trial showed I actually fell asleep a lot faster, like more than 10 minutes, I might think about it, but only if it cost about as much as a coffee for the whole year.
